We compared all managed Kubernetes options in Switzerland, including where we ourselves are not the best fit.

Seven options honestly assessed: self-hosted, Exoscale SKS, hyperscalers, VSHN, Swisscom, Infomaniak, and NKE. The uncomfortable part: hyperscalers often fall under the CLOUD Act even with Swiss data centres.

Full comparison with decision table on our blog. 🔍

https://nine.ch/en/blog/managed-kubernetes-switzerland-comparison/

#kubernetes #managedkubernetes #swisscloud #devops
